text:
maya: hi sec-team — need a quick console elevation (~30m) to redact PII from logs for INC-4532. won't be running migrations, just grep+sed in prod-logs. can someone approve?

sam: what's the exact scope and log paths? also who will observe/record the session? we need justification in the ticket.

maya: path: /var/log/services/crm/*.log and kubernetes logs in namespace `prod-logs`. ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4532. i'll be the operator — happy to share screen and keep session pinned.

ops-bot: BREAKGLASS request created: bg-8921 by maya for 30m. awaiting approval from eng-security. automated note: session will be recorded.

emma: quick thought — try `redact-tool --patterns "credit_card,ssn,email"` first, it handles most regexes and avoids elevation. did it miss something?

maya: tried redact-tool, it missed some dynamically formatted emails and base64 blobs that include PII. we need `kubectl logs -n prod-logs -l app=crm --since=48h` and then run targeted sed.

sam: ok. please paste the exact kubectl command you'll run and the AWS role/console you'll need. also add the justification snippet to INC-4532 (required by policy).

maya: command: `kubectl logs -n prod-logs -l app=crm --since=48h | grep -E "(user_email|payer_ssn)"` then manual redact and re-upload to the ticket. need AWS role `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-JustInTime-Admin` for console/eks access. window: 2026-03-18 14:00–14:30 UTC.

sam: copying the policy checklist: ephemeral role only, session recording enabled, no data exfil (no downloads), upload redacted output to the ticket, notify compliance@redwood after. if you follow that, i can provision the role for the 30m window.

sam: approved — granting `Redwood-JustInTime-Admin` for 30m starting at 2026-03-18 14:00 UTC. session will be proxied and recorded. please confirm when you've uploaded the redacted logs and then i'll revoke. :white_check_mark:

sec-audit-bot: Audit note created: bg-8921, approver=sam, operator=maya, scope=kubectl logs/prod-logs, duration=30m, recording_url=https://audit.redwood.internal/rec/bg-8921

maya: thanks — i'll start at 14:00, will share screen + link to uploaded redacted file in INC-4532 when done.

emma: if anything unexpected comes up ping me @emma and escalate.

maya: will do. thanks everyone.
